title: Nocturna

seo.title: Nocturna Shopify Case Study | Leandro Alonso
seo.description: How Leandro Alonso built Nocturna’s custom, merchant-editable Shopify storefront with 95+ Lighthouse performance.

cardSummary: A custom, merchant-editable storefront built from the ground up without unnecessary storefront apps.

hero.summary: A custom, mobile-first storefront for Rest Complex. Built on Shopify’s Horizon foundation, its major sections remain merchant-editable while the frontend stays lean and conversion-conscious.
hero.outcome: Custom where the brand needed it. Editable where the merchant needed it.

context: Nocturna is a single-product ecommerce brand selling Rest Complex, a dietary supplement focused on better rest.
The project called for a complete Shopify storefront rather than a limited theme adjustment.
challenge: The storefront needed a custom, conversion-oriented experience while remaining practical for the merchant to operate.
Major content areas had to remain editable without code, and the implementation needed to avoid unnecessary third-party storefront apps.
approach: I used Shopify’s Horizon foundation as the base, then developed the major storefront sections around the brand’s content and commerce needs.
Mobile behavior, theme-editor flexibility and performance were treated as requirements from the beginning.
solution: Developed the complete storefront and all major sections.
Made content and layout controls available through Shopify’s theme editor.
Kept routine merchant updates independent from code changes.
Implemented the required storefront experience without unnecessary third-party storefront apps.
Designed and developed the experience mobile-first.
uxCro: The information hierarchy supports a clear product story and a direct path to purchase.
The mobile composition keeps the core content and purchase journey easy to follow on smaller screens.
engineering: Custom sections provide the tailored experience while Shopify settings and blocks preserve editor control.
Avoiding unnecessary storefront apps keeps the implementation direct and reduces recurring app dependency.
results: A fully custom storefront whose major sections remain editable in Shopify.
The merchant can manage routine content changes without modifying code.
